title: QuoteItemTaxItem - Data API
description: The tax that is applied to a quote line item. This object is available in API version 55.0 and later.

Amount.description: The tax amount for the quote line item.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only for orgs with the multicurrency feature enabled. Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the org. Possible values are: BHD—Bahraini Dinar EUR—Euro JPY—Japanese Yen USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is 'USD'.

Description.description: User-defined description of the tax. For example, state sales tax or value-added tax (VAT).

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

ProductSurchargeId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProductSurchargeId.description: The product surcharge associated with the quote item tax item. This field is a relationship field. This field is available with Digital Insurance.

ProratedSurchargeAmount.description: The prorated portion of the tax amount based on the quote line item's effective dates. This field is available with Digital Insurance.

QuoteLineItemId.description: ID of the related quote line item. This is a relationship field.

Rate.description: If the tax is a percentage tax, then this field contains the percent value. If the tax is a fixed amount, then this field is null.

TaxEffectiveDate.description: The date used to calculate the tax rate.

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: Whether the tax is estimated or calculated by the tax provider. Possible values are: Actual Estimated
